1use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Dict;
2use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::dict::keys::COLOR_TRANSFORM;
3use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::stream::{FilterResult, ImageColorSpace, ImageData, ImageDecodeParams};
4use alloc::borrow::Cow;
5use core::num::NonZeroU32;
6use zune_jpeg::zune_core::bytestream::ZCursor;
7use zune_jpeg::zune_core::colorspace::ColorSpace;
8use zune_jpeg::zune_core::colorspace::ColorSpace::CMYK;
9use zune_jpeg::zune_core::options::DecoderOptions;
10
11pub(crate) fn decode(data: &[u8], params: &Dict<'_>, image_params: &ImageDecodeParams) -> Option<FilterResult<'static>> {
12    if image_params.width > u16::MAX as u32 || image_params.height > u16::MAX as u32 {
13        return None;
14    }
15
16    // Some PDFs have weird JPEGs where the JPEG metadata is completely wrong
17    // (for example indicating that one of the dimensions is u16::MAX), but the
18    // metadata in the PDF image dictionary is correct. Therefore, we first
19    // validate the JPEG metadata and patch the data if any of the dimensions
20    // are too large (if they are too small, they will just be padded later on).
21    let data = maybe_patch_jpeg_dimensions(data, image_params)?;
22
23    let options = DecoderOptions::default().set_max_width(u16::MAX as usize).set_max_height(u16::MAX as usize);
24    let mut decoder = zune_jpeg::JpegDecoder::new_with_options(ZCursor::new(&*data), options);
25    decoder.decode_headers().ok()?;
26
27    let color_transform = params.get::<u8>(COLOR_TRANSFORM);
28    let input_color_space = decoder.input_colorspace().unwrap();
29
30    let mut out_colorspace = if let Some(num_components) = image_params.num_components
31        && !matches!(num_components, 1 | 3 | 4)
32    {
33        ColorSpace::MultiBand(NonZeroU32::new(num_components as u32)?)
34    } else {
35        match input_color_space {
36            ColorSpace::YCbCr => {
37                if color_transform.is_none_or(|c| c == 1) {
38                    ColorSpace::RGB
39                } else {
40                    ColorSpace::YCbCr
41                }
42            }
43            ColorSpace::RGB | ColorSpace::RGBA => ColorSpace::RGB,
44            ColorSpace::Luma | ColorSpace::LumaA => ColorSpace::Luma,
45            // TODO: Find test case with color transform on cmyk
46            CMYK => CMYK,
47            ColorSpace::YCCK => ColorSpace::YCCK,
48            _ => ColorSpace::RGB,
49        }
50    };
51
52    // In case image had APP14 marker, we might have to override the colorspace.
53    if input_color_space == CMYK && decoder.info().unwrap().components == 3 {
54        out_colorspace = ColorSpace::RGB;
55    }
56
57    decoder.set_options(DecoderOptions::default().jpeg_set_out_colorspace(out_colorspace));
58    let mut decoded = decoder.decode().ok()?;
59
60    if out_colorspace == ColorSpace::YCCK {
61        // See <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/69595a29192b7704733404a42a2ebb537601117b/src/core/jpg.js#L1331>
62        for c in decoded.chunks_mut(4) {
63            let y = c[0] as f32;
64            let cb = c[1] as f32;
65            let cr = c[2] as f32;
66            c[0] = (434.456 - y - 1.402 * cr) as u8;
67            c[1] = (119.541 - y + 0.344 * cb + 0.714 * cr) as u8;
68            c[2] = (481.816 - y - 1.772 * cb) as u8;
69        }
70    }
71
72    let width = decoder.dimensions().unwrap().0 as u32;
73    let height = decoder.dimensions().unwrap().1 as u32;
74
75    let image_data = ImageData {
76        alpha: None,
77        color_space: match out_colorspace {
78            ColorSpace::RGB | ColorSpace::YCbCr => Some(ImageColorSpace::Rgb),
79            ColorSpace::Luma => Some(ImageColorSpace::Gray),
80            ColorSpace::YCCK | CMYK => Some(ImageColorSpace::Cmyk),
81            ColorSpace::MultiBand(_) => None,
82            _ => None,
83        },
84        bits_per_component: 8,
85        width,
86        height,
87    };
88
89    Some(FilterResult { data: Cow::Owned(decoded), image_data: Some(image_data) })
90}

92fn maybe_patch_jpeg_dimensions<'a>(data: &'a [u8], image_params: &ImageDecodeParams) -> Option<Cow<'a, [u8]>> {
93    let sof_offset = find_sof_marker(data)?;
94
95    let height_offset = sof_offset.checked_add(5)?;
96    let width_offset = sof_offset.checked_add(7)?;
97
98    let jpeg_height = u16::from_be_bytes([*data.get(height_offset)?, *data.get(height_offset.checked_add(1)?)?]);
99    let jpeg_width = u16::from_be_bytes([*data.get(width_offset)?, *data.get(width_offset.checked_add(1)?)?]);
100
101    let jpeg_area = (jpeg_width as usize).checked_mul(jpeg_height as usize)?;
102    let image_area = (image_params.width as usize).checked_mul(image_params.height as usize)?;
103    let need_patch = jpeg_area > image_area;
104
105    if !need_patch {
106        return Some(Cow::Borrowed(data));
107    }
108
109    let target_w = (image_params.width as u16).to_be_bytes();
110    let target_h = (image_params.height as u16).to_be_bytes();
111
112    let mut patched = data.to_vec();
113    patched[height_offset..height_offset.checked_add(2)?].copy_from_slice(&target_h);
114    patched[width_offset..width_offset.checked_add(2)?].copy_from_slice(&target_w);
115
116    Some(Cow::Owned(patched))
117}
118
119fn find_sof_marker(data: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {
120    let mut i = 0_usize;
121
122    while i.checked_add(1).is_some_and(|next| next < data.len()) {
123        if data[i] != 0xFF {
124            i += 1;
125            continue;
126        }
127
128        let marker = data[i + 1];
129
130        // Note: Not sure if 100% correct/robust, is AI-generated.
131        match marker {
132            // All SOF markers carry dimensions: SOF0–SOF15, excluding
133            // 0xC4 (DHT), 0xC8 (JPG), 0xCC (DAC) which are not frame markers.
134            0xC0..=0xCF if marker != 0xC4 && marker != 0xC8 && marker != 0xCC => {
135                return Some(i);
136            }
137            // Skip padding bytes (0xFF followed by 0xFF).
138            0xFF => {
139                i += 1;
140
141                continue;
142            }
143            // SOI (0xD8), EOI (0xD9), TEM (0x01) and stuffed byte (0x00)
144            // are standalone markers with no payload.
145            0xD8 | 0xD9 | 0x01 | 0x00 => {
146                i += 2;
147
148                continue;
149            }
150            // All other markers have a 2-byte length field — skip over them.
151            _ => {
152                let len_start = i.checked_add(2)?;
153                let len_end = i.checked_add(3)?;
154                let seg_len = u16::from_be_bytes([*data.get(len_start)?, *data.get(len_end)?]) as usize;
155
156                i = i.checked_add(2)?.checked_add(seg_len)?;
157            }
158        }
159    }
160
161    None
162}
